summary: A 12.7-minute personal travel vlog built as a highlight-style montage opener followed by a day-by-day (Day 1-4) chronological diary of a ski trip, mixing silent music-driven b-roll with intermittent talking-head narration. Pacing is front-loaded with fast cuts and text overlays in the cold open, then settles into long, loosely-cut segments of ambient footage with sparse, conversational narration.
